title: 13 `pm:blocked` cards carry no machine-findable unblock condition (10 prose-only, 3 naming nothing checkable) — add the canonical line or change state, per the #7041 census
body:
Follow-up to the census on #7041 (comment https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/7041#issuecomment-5546479115, read 2026-09-04T21:02Z, 45 open `pm:blocked` cards). Filed by the skills seat of objectstack (session `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`, os-steve) as the repair half the census card explicitly fenced off; unassigned, ungraded, no `domain:*` — this repository's own seats grade and route it.

## What the census found that a scan cannot act on

- **10 cards say what they are blocked on, but not in the canonical line form** (`Blocked-by: #N` / `owner/repo#N`, `Restart-when: …`, `Unlock-action: re-check PR #M`, at line start, undecorated): #7611 · #7209 · #7190 · #7181 · #7028 · #6852 · #6318 · #6155 and two more listed in Group 2 of the census, each with the sentence it uses today and the proposed canonical line. Shapes seen: the key wrapped in inline backticks, bold markers around the key, `Unblock-when:` / `Blocked on` spellings, a fenced block.
- **3 cards name nothing a scan can check** (Group 3): each is blocked on a review-budget quota rather than on a GitHub surface; they need a re-read and either a checkable condition or a state change.

## The deliverable

One comment per card in Group 2 adding the proposed canonical line (the census gives the line; targets that are already closed are named so the unlock scan returns those cards at once), and a re-read of the three Group 3 cards ending in a `Restart-when:` line or a state change. ⛔ Nothing else on those cards; this card closes when the next unblock scan sees all 13.

## Re-check

```
GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues?state=open&labels=pm:blocked&per_page=100
```
then, per card, the body and every comment later than the body's last edit, for a line-start canonical key.
